# User guide

## Open the presentation

Open the public review presentation at <https://claycobusinesssolutions.github.io/RBB-GALLERY/>. The README says no password or GitHub account is required ([README.md:3-5](../README.md#L3-L5)). The repository calls this a public review link; it does not confirm that the URL is a production deployment.

For a local preview, run `python3 launch.py --no-open` from the repository root and open the loopback URL printed in the terminal ([README.md:16](../README.md#L16), [launch.py:56-65](../launch.py#L56-L65)).

## Navigate

- Use **Next** / **Previous** or the keyboard arrow keys to move between scenes. Press **F** for full screen and **G** to open the menu ([README.md:7-10](../README.md#L7-L10)).
- In the menu, choose a chapter or scene. The menu groups the presentation into Invitation, Seminal projects, Art and collaboration, and Possibilities ([deck/src/museum-menu.js:6-23](../deck/src/museum-menu.js#L6-L23)).
- On a phone, use the hamburger menu and the large Previous / Next controls; project and office-photo sections use mobile-oriented layouts ([README.md:12](../README.md#L12)).

## Main features

1. **Project gallery:** Advance through the civic, work/care, and industrial project scenes. Select a project card to open its detail dialog; browse grouped projects with **Previous** / **Next**, select a group member, and use **View project on Clayco** to open the external source. Project cards and the detail dialog are implemented in [deck/src/seminal-projects.js:14-42](../deck/src/seminal-projects.js#L14-L42).
2. **The Clark Collection:** Open the collection scene and browse its moving artwork field. Use **About the collection** for the explanatory content or follow the `clarkcollection.org` link ([deck/index.html:26](../deck/index.html#L26)).
3. **Art in our spaces / Hope Plaza:** Navigate to these menu chapters to see the photo galleries and reference links ([deck/src/museum-menu.js:8-10](../deck/src/museum-menu.js#L8-L10), [deck/index.html:74](../deck/index.html#L74)).
4. **Possibilities:** Navigate through the optional exhibit-space concept studies. The page labels them as opportunities for discussion, not a selected venue or final design ([deck/index.html:81-125](../deck/index.html#L81-L125)).

The current scene is reflected in the URL hash and saved in session storage so a reload can resume the presentation ([deck/src/presentation.js:192-212](../deck/src/presentation.js#L192-L212)).

## Troubleshooting

- **Presentation does not open:** Reload the public link. If an old tab still shows an update/migration message, close it and reopen the public link as directed by the page ([public.js:21-37](../public.js#L21-L37)).
- **Project details or artwork are missing:** Reload after network access to the public static site is available; these catalogues are loaded from same-origin JSON files ([deck/src/seminal-projects.js:14-17](../deck/src/seminal-projects.js#L14-L17), [deck/src/presentation.js:116-125](../deck/src/presentation.js#L116-L125)).
- **External source link unavailable:** The project, collection, and Hope Plaza links leave the presentation for the linked public website. Return to the presentation tab to continue.
- **Local preview not reachable:** Keep the `launch.py` terminal running and use the loopback URL it prints ([launch.py:61-68](../launch.py#L61-L68)).
